summary: fix(settings): compile the bundle for Firefox 95 and newer
description:
Because:

- The production browserslist resolves to Firefox 121, so Babel can ship syntax 95-120 can't parse.
- crypto.randomUUID(), called at bundle load, already sets the real floor at 95.

This commit:

- Adds "Firefox >= 95" to the fxa-settings production browserslist.

Closes: FXA-7397
